trust_decision.summary: The WebSocket server decides, per relayed message, whether the sender is a trusted server-side PHP/CLI sender (token sentFrom=='php' or isCommandLineInterface) allowed to carry autoEvalCodeOnHTML (which every receiving browser eval()s); browser/guest messages must have it stripped from every carrier that msgToResourceId turns into the outgoing msg (json, msg, or the whole message), but the pinned code strips only $json['msg'].

landing_point.why: The summary names the autoEvalCodeOnHTML strip and the $msg['json'] relay; MessageSQLiteV2.php is the implementation server.php.php loads when PDO SQLite is present (plugin/YPTSocket/server.php.php:48-51), and grepping autoEvalCodeOnHTML lands on its strip block.

fix_sites.entry_point: WebSocket message to the Ratchet socket server (Message::onMessage default branch), SQLite build loaded by plugin/YPTSocket/server.php.php:51
WebSocket message to the Ratchet socket server (Message::onMessage default branch), non-SQLite fallback loaded by plugin/YPTSocket/server.php.php:54
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation (in-memory fallback when PDO SQLite is missing)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: plugin/YPTSocket/Message.php:240-243 (loaded only when PDO SQLite is unavailable, plugin/YPTSocket/server.php.php:48-55)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Message.php is the no-SQLite fallback that server.php.php only loads after logging an error that tells the admin to install php-sqlite3, so a solver could treat it as a degraded/legacy build and patch only MessageSQLiteV2.php.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Server-originated messages legitimately carry autoEvalCodeOnHTML in the same 'json' carrier the attacker uses (sendIO puts the payload in ->json with a sentFrom='php' token); LiveLinks removal and Live image refresh rely on clients eval()ing it. Stripping json.autoEvalCodeOnHTML unconditionally, or removing the client eval, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: autoEvalCodeOnHTML under msg (msg as object) - already stripped pre-fix
autoEvalCodeOnHTML under json (json non-empty takes precedence as outgoing msg, Message.php:316-317 / MessageSQLiteV2.php:396-397)
autoEvalCodeOnHTML at top level when json and msg are empty (fallback $obj['msg'] = $msg, MessageSQLiteV2.php:400-401)

O7_producer.where: Trust bit comes from the encrypted token built by getEncryptedInfo (plugin/YPTSocket/functions.php:3-9); the carrier choice is made in msgToResourceId (plugin/YPTSocket/MessageSQLiteV2.php:396-402), same file as the check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third, older implementation with the same msg-only strip and the same json/msg/whole-message carrier selection (plugin/YPTSocket/MessageSQLite.php:361-367); it is not required by any server entry point at the pinned commit, so it would only count if our copy wires it in (e.g. as a selectable backend in server.php.php).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already keeps three parallel Message classes; a maintainer adding a backend switch could easily load the v1 SQLite class, and patch authors demonstrably update only the copies they remember.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A dedicated relay branch (like redirectLive) that forwards a sub-object of $json to msgToAllSameLive could be placed before the strip, or forward a re-decoded copy of the raw message.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The redirectLive branch already reaches into $json['json'] for routing; a feature-specific relay built from the raw $msg string is a plausible maintainer shortcut.

O9_family: Client-side code injection via relayed eval field (CWE-94 / stored-in-transit XSS through WebSocket broadcast)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8 + Composer vendor (Ratchet/ReactPHP); class instantiation needs videos/configuration.php
O10_build.project_tests: No project tests for YPTSocket found at the pinned commit (no matches under tests/); plugin/YPTSocket/test.php is a manual script.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add unset($json['json']['autoEvalCodeOnHTML']) next to the existing msg unset in MessageSQLiteV2.php only, missing the top-level fallback carrier and the Message.php fallback implementation.

out_of_scope_notes: Production deployments may use the external Node 'yptsocket' binary downloaded by plugin/YPTSocket/server.node.php:13-15 (separate repo WWBN/AVideo-Socket); its relay logic is not in this repository.
plugin/YPTSocket/worker.php:126 calls eval($exec) in a PHP worker; different sink, not examined.
plugin/YPTSocket/server2.php:16 requires Message2.php, which does not exist at the pinned commit (dead entry point).
unverified: repo_mb not measured; giant_repo/tiny_repo flags not evaluated (AVideo is a large monorepo, likely well above 5 MB).
